newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling fell against the dollar on Friday as a downward trend persisted into a second week, commercial and central bank dealers said.

An official at the central Bank of Tanzania (BoT) said the shilling was posted at a mean commercial rate of 597.9600 versus the dollar compared to 597.0987 on Thursday, 594.9900 last Friday and 592.5546 two weeks ago.

The dealer said the shilling was quoted at an average of 974.8856 against the pound, slightly firmer compared to 975.0652 on Thursday -- but still considerably lower compared to a commercial rate of 937.6990 two weeks ago.

"What we see at the central bank is that there is a high demand for dollars in the market but the Bank of Tanzania does not plan to intervene unless there is unusually high fluctuation," a BoT official told Reuters.
"It's just a normal fluctuation. We are not concerned about it," the official added.
